definitionZh: 布莱德调整中风或其他形式印刷颜色中的整体黑暗,总体宽度,换行或页面布局没有任何变化. 负值使得字体外观更轻,而正值使它更暗,类似于墨血或点在纸上增益.
sourceDefinition: Bleed adjusts the overall darkness in the typographic color of strokes or other forms, without any changes in overall width, line breaks, or page layout. Negative values make the font appearance lighter, while positive values make it darker, similarly to ink bleed or dot gain on paper.
